report.scene: A hand holds the severed end of a black charger cord with exposed wires, while an opened black charger case, yellow insulating shields and the rest of the cord lie on a white surface behind it.

matching_details: Black cord strain relief with ribbed, dotted grip at the cut end, held at left, matches the cord collar in official image 2
Black rounded charger case shell at right matches the shape of the case in official image 1
Thin black cord with a ferrite bead and barrel plug at center back matches the cord and plug in official image 1
differing_details: The charger case is pried open and its internal yellow shielding is removed, so the case cannot be compared fully; no brand or label is visible
product.reason_plain: Likely the same charger: black case, ribbed cord collar and barrel plug match, but no label or model is visible.
product.reason_technical: Strain relief texture, case profile, ferrite bead and barrel plug match the official images. No printed brand, label or model number is readable to confirm the exact product, so score stays below 0.9.

actions.evidence: At left center, the cord is severed at its strain relief collar where it attaches to the case, with stranded bare wires and a white insulated wire sticking out of the cut end. The opened case is at right.

photo_source.reason: Real hand, natural shadows, shallow focus and a casual tabletop setting with no screen or print artifacts.

report.retake_tip: Please include the label on the charger case in the photo so we can read the brand and model.
